title: Semi-quantitative Measure of Roots Colonization by Arbuscular Mycorrhizal Fungi
author: Florence Blanchard
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zbgf2jw
materials: One to three vesicles, small if many

steps.title: Prepare slides for observation
steps.instruction: Prepare slides by placing root segments parallel to one another in multiple columns from top to bottom of the slides, using a 3x3 frame.

substeps.instruction: Separate roots into three diameter categories: small, medium, and large.
Cut roots into 1 cm long fragments.
Ink stain roots following the ink and vinegar protocol (Vierheilig et al., 1998).

steps.title: Set up analysis working sheet
steps.instruction: Create a working sheet where rows contain unique identifiers for the observation, individual, and diameter class (P: Small, M: Medium, G: Large), and columns are dedicated to the following structures and scales:

substeps.instruction: Vesicles (Ves): 0 (None), 1 (One to three, small if many), 2 (Some, 4-6), 3 (Many, >6 and/or very large)
VAM hyphae < 2 µm (Hyp.amf): 0 (None), 1 (Isolated fragments), 2 (Many unbroken hyphae and/or at least two visible appressorium), 3 (Colonization of approx 60% or more of the cortex)

Endophytes/Other fungi (Endo): 0 (None), 1 (Isolated hyphae ≤ 2 µm or microsclerotia), 2 (Some fragments or microsclerotia), 3 (Many fragments/microsclerotia and/or >3 cells showing signs of parasitism by chytrids fungi)
General Presence: Neg (Negative, no fungal structure) or Pres (Presence, at least one fungal structure)

steps.title: Initialize microscope observation
steps.instruction: Observe slides under a light microscope at 200x magnification (though higher or lower magnification may be used to identify structures).

substeps.instruction: Begin observation at the first field filled by the length of a root from the left of the slide (regardless of whether it is the 1st or 3rd root of the column).

steps.title: Record fungal structures
steps.instruction: Record the presence of fungal structures in the root, categorizing the structures and estimating the amount using the semi-quantitative scale (0-3).

substeps.instruction: Exclude debris or any material clearly outside the root, even if the root is broken.

steps.title: Scan roots in a comb-like pattern
steps.instruction: Systematically observe the roots using a comb-like movement pattern across the slide.

substeps.instruction: Move the field of view vertically toward other roots, counting only in root segments that fill the field of view.
Shift the field of view horizontally to the direct right by a distance equal to the field.
Repeat the vertical and horizontal movements to cover the roots.
If roots are aligned vertically, treat a complete vertical change in the field of view as a distinct observation.

steps.title: Complete slide analysis
steps.instruction: Continue the scanning process until the end of the root column is reached.

substeps.instruction: If columns are well separated, restart from the first field filled by a root from the left of the column.
If columns overlap, continue the observation pattern across them.
